instructions.title: How to use Gradient Generator

steps.title: Choose gradient type
steps.description: Select between linear (straight-line), radial (circular/elliptical), or conic (rotational) gradient types depending on the background effect you want to achieve.

steps.title: Add and configure color stops
steps.description: Add at least two color stops with your chosen colors. Drag stops on the gradient bar to adjust their positions, or enter exact percentage values for precise placement.

steps.title: Adjust direction and angle
steps.description: For linear gradients, set the angle (0°=top, 90°=right, 180°=bottom). For radial gradients, configure the shape and focal point. For conic gradients, set the starting angle.

steps.title: Copy and use the CSS code
steps.description: Copy the generated CSS background-image property, Tailwind gradient classes, or SVG code from the output panel. Paste directly into your stylesheet, component, or design file.

troubleshooting: Gradient not showing: Ensure at least two distinct color stops are defined
Sharp color bands: Add intermediate color stops between harsh transitions to smooth them
Gradient cuts off: Check that color stop positions span from 0% to 100%
Tailwind export not matching: Tailwind only supports two-stop linear gradients natively — use CSS export for complex gradients
Safari rendering issue: Add -webkit- prefix if needed; the CSS output includes this automatically
